name: hard-imagenet-medium
description: A curated subset of ImageNet composed of images that are consistently hard for standard classifiers. It measures model robustness and generalization by evaluating top-1 accuracy on challenging, misclassified examples. The 'medium' variant balances evaluation cost and difficulty by providing a moderate-size hard test set.
reputation: Used by robustness and benchmarking researchers as a challenging ImageNet subset; moderate adoption in the community.
